acceptance.given: A frozen non-empty Consumer Manifest and the reconciled repository real-call surface, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers, are available.

oracle.expected: Every applicable Consumer completes enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real call surface; rollback observes the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A manifest entry lacks a reconciled real caller.
Configuration-only switching is accepted as rollback.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer transition call receipts and the bidirectional Consumer Manifest/call-surface reconciliation.

acceptance.then: All applicable transitions for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry are complete.
acceptance.when: The Consumer transition selector executes against the frozen manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Consumer transition selector with one applicable real-call-surface transition omitted or unreachable.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete non-empty Consumer Manifest bidirectionally with the repository real-call surface, then require each applicable Consumer to execute enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real interface.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Consumer routes and require rollback to reproduce the bound Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen manifest with applicable transitions pending -> every applicable Consumer has real-call receipts for enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector proves 100% transition completion for the reconciled non-empty manifest and rejects omissions, unreachable consumers, and configuration-only rollback.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and its bound target, validator capability, dependencies, command, Probe, output, Consumer, snapshot, and non-authority inputs are available for independent checking.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records an independently verified Validator Capability binding rather than relying on a self-reported capability or version string.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result lacks independent Validator Capability verification.
Validator version text alone establishes capability trust.
oracle.observable: Replay Result binding record and the independent Validator Capability verification outcome.

acceptance.then: Validator Capability is independently verified for that successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: The replay selector evaluates a successful Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the successful-replay selector with the independent Validator Capability binding removed or substituted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each successful Replay Result to bind independently verified Validator Capability content and dependencies before success is retained.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve replay-result compatibility while rejecting successful results whose Validator Capability binding is not independently established.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful Replay Result without independently established Validator Capability -> successful Replay Result carrying an independently verified capability binding.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector accepts a successful Replay Result only when its independent Validator Capability verification is recorded and rejects missing, substituted, self-reported, or version-only capability evidence.

acceptance.given: A Candidate Package is selected for a Matrix Case with its candidate identity and evaluated-change content available for comparison.

oracle.expected: Candidate identity and content demonstrate that the selected Candidate contains the real change under evaluation.
forbidden: A Candidate without the evaluated real change is compared.
A comparison subject is labeled Candidate without containing the relevant change.
oracle.observable: Candidate identity/content comparison against the evaluated-change binding.

acceptance.then: The Candidate is bound to the real evaluated change before Matrix Case comparison.
acceptance.when: A Candidate Package is selected for a Matrix Case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Candidate eligibility selector with a Candidate identity that omits the bound evaluated change.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind Candidate selection to content that contains the real evaluated change and reject a label or identity that is not backed by that content.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve Stable/Candidate comparison compatibility while rejecting Candidates that cannot prove inclusion of the evaluated change.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate selected by label or incomplete identity -> Candidate selection bound to content containing the evaluated real change.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector rejects any Candidate whose identity/content does not include the evaluated real change and accepts only a content-backed Candidate binding.

acceptance.given: The frozen historical repository-relative path inventory and the current repair working tree are available for comparison.

oracle.expected: The repository-relative path comparison reports no renamed, relocated, or rewritten historical paths after repair evaluation.
oracle.observable: Deterministic before/after repository-relative path inventory comparison performed during repair validation.

acceptance.when: Repair validation compares the frozen path inventory with the current repository state.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the historical path-integrity selector after a rename, relocation, or rewrite of a frozen repository-relative path.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve frozen repository-relative path identities and reject repair validation when the before/after path inventory differs.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No repository-relative path migration is permitted; historical path identities remain compatible and unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen repository-relative path inventory -> compared current inventory with identical historical path identities.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The path-integrity selector reports equality for the frozen and current repository-relative path inventories and fails on any rename, relocation, or rewrite.
